facts.value: In the context of your study program at our Department of Economics, you can complete certain modules at other departments, so-called import modules from other departments - these also include optional modules. This is only possible based on existing cooperation agreements between the departments.
facts.programme_association: Master Thesis - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: For the degree programs of the Department of Economics, an overview has been compiled which import modules you can register for at other departments and how you can integrate these import modules into your study program at the Department of Economics. Furthermore, you cannot include any other modules from other departments into your study program at the Department of Economics and also cannot gain different Credit Points (CP).
